name: 黄蜂后
evolution: 一窝蜂 → 黄蜂后 Lv.21 → 花魁蜂后 Lv.38 → 女王蜂
evolutionEn: Yiwofeng → Huangfenghou Lv.21 → Huakuifenghou Lv.38 → NWangfeng
description: 在蜂后的下半身周围有能量波动，推测是用来建立两只小蜂的联系。战斗时，蜂后的两眼会变成红色，针刺也会变得锋利无比。
descriptionEn: There is an energy fluctuation around the lower body of the queen bee, presumably used to establish a connection between the two small bees. In battle, the queen's eyes turn red and her stinger becomes extremely sharp.

skills.name: 鸣叫
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 虫网
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; restore 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 虫茧
skills.description: 自己回复20%生命，己方队伍获得1次奉献：获得10%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Restore 20% HP to self; ally team gains 1 Devotion: gain 10% lifesteal.

skills.name: 虫鸣
skills.description: 造成魔伤，队伍中的精灵每携带1个虫鸣，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each Bug Chirp carried by allies, this skill's combo count +1.

skills.name: 捆缚
skills.description: 敌方获得2层中毒，获得1次奉献：敌方获得2层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 2 Poison stacks; gain 1 Devotion: enemy gains 2 Poison stacks.

skills.name: 风矢
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if attacking first, this skill's power +50%.

skills.name: 草虫冲击
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次威力+50且无视敌方系别抵抗。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switches this turn, this power +50 and ignores enemy type resistance.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。
skills.descriptionEn: Gain +20 to all skill power; Swift.

skills.name: 虫群过境
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击。己方队伍获得1次奉献：获得连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2-hit combo. Ally team gains 1 Devotion: combo count +1.

skills.name: 虫群
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，本技能会受奉献影响。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; this skill is affected by Devotion.

skills.name: 翅刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，驱散敌方所有印记，应对状态：改为偷取印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; dispel all enemy marks; on counter: steal marks instead.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; Swift; on counter: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.
